Which statement best describes the iterative nature of modeling?

```{mcq}
#| label: d01-iterative
1. Build a model, examine how well it captures important aspects of reality, and improve it when needed. [correct]
2. Build a model once and then treat it as permanently correct.
3. Replace heuristic reasoning with formal reasoning before building the model.
4. Avoid checking a model against reality because models are representations.
```

:::
